text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Strong, strong, strong!
Narita Brian conquers the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaah------!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*..., *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The stands are roaring with cheers!
Kyoto Racecourse is enveloped in voices of celebration!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I managed to safely claim victory
in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I think so too.
This past year—or maybe ever since my debut.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You want me to—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, whoa whoa whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why are you trying to wrap this up already?!
You guys are dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, Ama-san, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's me!
And Brian, step outside. We need to talk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us fulfill the promise from back then,
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've come all this way—we can't just end it
with a "we both did our best," can we?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. A victory of this
caliber will never satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah, at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Narita Brian returned to the waiting room
afterward looking pleased, she was overflowing
with fighting spirit.
